tools.name: detect_language
tools.description:
Detect language of text using character frequency analysis.
    Returns: {language, confidence, method}

tools.name: analyze_sentiment
tools.description:
Analyze sentiment of text (positive/negative/neutral).
    Returns: {score, label, confidence}

tools.name: extract_keywords
tools.description:
Extract top keywords from text using TF scoring.
    Returns: {keywords: [{word, score}], total_words}

tools.name: find_duplicates
tools.description:
Find duplicate or near-duplicate texts using Jaccard similarity.
    Returns: {duplicates: [{text1_idx, text2_idx, similarity}]}

tools.name: summarize_text
tools.description:
Extractive summarization — picks most important sentences.
    Returns: {summary, sentences_used, original_length}
